user.title: Configure Tivoo
user.description: Set the HA media directory and ESP32 IPv4 address. Enter the Bluetooth Classic MAC shown for your Tivoo-audio device; confirm it with a phone Bluetooth scan. Do not use the Tivoo-light BLE address.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Tivoo
reconfigure.description: Update the ESP32 IPv4 address or selected Tivoo device. When replacing the Tivoo, scan and confirm the new Tivoo-audio Classic Bluetooth MAC with your phone, then enter it here. Do not use the Tivoo-light BLE address.
